name: disk_standing_receipt_skips_invalid_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1527: standing_hygiene_status returned invalid_receipt on the FIRST unreadable
or unusable receipt, so one refused run on 2026-11-05 that wrote run_id null blinded the
directory: disk_hygiene_digest/disk_hygiene_alert queued nothing from 2026-11-02T15:45, a
refused run holding 25.0 GiB was never reported, and / sat critical at 92.9%. Pins that an
unusable receipt is skipped and counted, that invalid_receipt survives only for a directory
with nothing usable, and that a report older than the reviewed freshness bound is not news
